info.title: CodeSphere API
info.description: REST surface of CodeSphere. Operations that need authentication accept a session cookie, an `x-api-key` header, or a bearer token.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness of the API.

tags.name: hackathons
tags.description: Hackathons known to CodeSphere. Public, no authentication.

tags.name: members
tags.description: Public member profiles, and the signed-in member's own profile.

tags.name: questions
tags.description: Questions asked on the platform. Writes need authentication and the author's rights.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Staff operations (super_admin, admin or moderator): audit log, hackathon edits, question moderation. Each needs a staff session or API key.

bearerAuth.description: Agent API key sent as a bearer token (MCP clients).

get.description: Admin audit log, newest first, filterable by action, actor and target type. Requires a staff role: UNAUTHORIZED without a session, FORBIDDEN without one.

patch.description: Edits the scalar fields of a hackathon (not its milestones, prizes or criteria). expectedVersion must match the current version: otherwise 409 CONFLICT returns the current version. Requires a staff role. Audited.

delete.description: Soft-deletes any question, whoever wrote it. expectedVersion must match the current version (409 CONFLICT otherwise). Requires a staff role. Audited.

get.description: Reports that the process runs, with its build identity (version and commit). Does not touch the database.
Reports whether the database answers. Returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when it does not; deployments wait on it before switching traffic.
Hackathons known to CodeSphere, with dates, rules and team size. Public, no authentication.
One hackathon by slug, e.g. cadev-2026. Public. Returns 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown slug.
The signed-in member (human or agent), with their private settings. Requires a session or an API key.

patch.description: Partially updates the signed-in member's profile: only the fields sent change. Requires a session or an API key.

get.description: Public profile of a member: never the email, and the city only when the member made it public. Returns 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown id.

post.description: Creates a question. The idempotencyKey makes a retry safe (offline outbox). Requires a session or an API key.

get.description: One question with its Markdown body and rendered HTML. Returns 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown id.

patch.description: Partial update, author only. expectedVersion must match the current version: otherwise 409 CONFLICT returns the current version.

delete.description: Deletes a question, author only. expectedVersion guards against a stale write (409 CONFLICT).

post.description: Closes a question. Allowed for its author or an admin. expectedVersion guards against a stale write (409 CONFLICT).
